runtime.description: The deployment target is identified and its deployment configuration is valid.

database.description: Database schema changes and connections are controlled.

observability.description: Logs, metrics and health signals are configured.

governance.description: Policy is enforced fail-closed at runtime and changes are controlled.

auditability.description: Audit records are durable, tamper-evident and free of secrets.

cloudflare-workers.description: Cloudflare Workers defined in wrangler.toml / wrangler.json(c).

vercel.description: Vercel project (vercel.json and/or a framework build in package.json).

evidence_types.deployment_config: Platform deployment config: compose file, wrangler.toml/json, vercel.json, firebase.json, or equivalent.
evidence_types.lockfile: package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock or equivalent.
evidence_types.database_config: Config or code that builds database connections.
evidence_types.observability_config: Logging/metrics config (e.g. wrangler [observability], Vercel log drains, Prometheus config, Cloud Logging setup).
evidence_types.health_endpoint: Source or config defining a health/readiness endpoint.
evidence_types.repository_files: The supplied repository files that are in scope.
evidence_types.secret_scan_report: Output of a secret scanner run over the scoped files.
evidence_types.secret_config: How secrets are injected: platform secret bindings, env var references, .gitignore entries for env files.
evidence_types.auth_config: Authentication/authorization middleware or config and the routes it covers.
evidence_types.dependency_scan_config: Dependabot, CodeQL, npm audit, pip-audit or similar config.
evidence_types.deny_by_default_policy: Policy source showing the default decision is deny.
evidence_types.failure_path: Code showing what happens when the policy engine or a dependency errors.
evidence_types.policy_source: Policy definitions (e.g. OPA/Rego, Cedar, allowlists, RLS policies).
evidence_types.enforcement_code_path: Code showing the policy is evaluated before the governed action executes.
evidence_types.audit_storage: Schema or config of where audit records are stored.
evidence_types.write_protection: Evidence that audit records cannot be updated or deleted (grants, triggers, WORM/append-only settings).
evidence_types.audit_write_code: Code that builds and writes audit records.
evidence_types.audit_integrity: Hash chain, signature or checksum mechanism over audit records.

evaluation.pass_when: At least one supported platform config is supplied and parses, and it names the service being deployed.
evaluation.fail_when: The supplied deployment config does not parse, or it targets a different service or platform than the one being validated.

evaluation.pass_when: Every supplied package manifest has a matching committed lockfile.
evaluation.fail_when: A supplied package manifest has no lockfile, or the lockfile is listed in .gitignore.

evaluation.pass_when: The deploy job runs only after build and test jobs succeed.
evaluation.fail_when: The deploy job can run without the build/test jobs succeeding (no needs/if gate, or tests are allowed to fail).

evaluation.pass_when: The compose file parses and every service has an image or build.
evaluation.fail_when: The compose file does not parse, or a service has neither image nor build.

evaluation.pass_when: Every image reference has an explicit tag other than latest, or a digest.
evaluation.fail_when: An image has no tag or uses the latest tag.

evaluation.pass_when: Every long-running service defines a healthcheck.
evaluation.fail_when: A long-running service has no healthcheck.

evaluation.pass_when: The wrangler config parses and sets name, main and compatibility_date.
evaluation.fail_when: The wrangler config does not parse, or name, main or compatibility_date is missing.

evaluation.pass_when: vercel.json (if present) parses and a build is defined (buildCommand, a framework preset, or a build script in package.json).
evaluation.fail_when: vercel.json does not parse, or no build is defined.

evaluation.pass_when: firebase.json parses, defines the deployed targets (hosting, functions, firestore, etc.), and .firebaserc maps a project alias.
evaluation.fail_when: firebase.json does not parse, defines no deploy targets, or no project alias is mapped.

evaluation.pass_when: Schema changes are in ordered, versioned migration files.
evaluation.fail_when: Schema is changed outside migrations (e.g. ad-hoc DDL in app startup) or migration ordering conflicts.

evaluation.pass_when: Database connection settings come from environment variables, secret bindings or a secret manager.
evaluation.fail_when: A literal password, key or full connection string with credentials appears in the supplied files.

evaluation.pass_when: Firestore rules restrict reads and writes by auth and/or ownership on every match block.
evaluation.fail_when: A match block allows read or write unconditionally (e.g. if true) or only by a date check.

evaluation.pass_when: Logging/telemetry is enabled in config for each identified platform (e.g. wrangler [observability] enabled = true, Vercel log drain, Prometheus scrape, Cloud Logging).
evaluation.fail_when: Config explicitly disables logging/telemetry for a deployed service.

evaluation.pass_when: A health or readiness endpoint is defined for each deployed service.
evaluation.fail_when: A deployed service has no health or readiness endpoint.

evaluation.pass_when: A Prometheus scrape config targets the deployed services.
evaluation.fail_when: Prometheus config is supplied but does not target the deployed services.

evaluation.pass_when: Grafana provisioning includes a data source for the Prometheus instance and at least one dashboard.
evaluation.fail_when: Grafana provisioning is supplied but has no data source or no dashboard.

evaluation.pass_when: A secret scan over the scoped files reports no findings, and no literal credentials appear in the supplied files.
evaluation.fail_when: A literal credential (API key, token, password, private key) appears in a supplied file or the scan reports a finding.

evaluation.pass_when: Secrets are referenced from the platform secret store or environment, and local env files are gitignored.
evaluation.fail_when: Secrets are set as plain config vars in a committed file, or env files with secrets are committed.

evaluation.pass_when: Every non-public route or tool passes authentication/authorization before its handler runs.
evaluation.fail_when: A non-public route or tool is reachable without authentication.

evaluation.pass_when: Dependency scanning is configured (e.g. Dependabot, CodeQL, npm audit or pip-audit in CI).
evaluation.fail_when: Dependency scanning is configured but disabled or set to never fail.

evaluation.pass_when: The default decision is deny and errors in the policy path deny the action.
evaluation.fail_when: The default decision is allow, or an error in the policy path lets the action proceed.

evaluation.pass_when: The policy is evaluated in code before the governed action executes, on every path to that action.
evaluation.fail_when: A path executes the governed action without evaluating the policy, or the policy is only documented.

evaluation.pass_when: Production deploys run only from a protected branch that requires review and passing checks.
evaluation.fail_when: Production can be deployed from an unprotected branch or without review.

evaluation.pass_when: Audit records are append-only: update and delete are denied for application roles.
evaluation.fail_when: Application roles can update or delete audit records.

controls.name: Audit records free of secrets and raw input

evaluation.pass_when: Audit writes store codes, identifiers and hashes, not secrets or raw client-supplied text.
evaluation.fail_when: Audit writes store secrets, tokens or raw client-supplied text.

evaluation.pass_when: Audit records carry a hash chain, signature or checksum that is verified.
evaluation.fail_when: An integrity mechanism exists but is not verified or can be bypassed.
